title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 28% Cashback ($150 Cap/Member, Min Spend $50, Max Spend $1000, 6PM-11:59pm) @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 28% Cashback ($150 Cap/Member, Min Spend $50, Max Spend $1000, 6PM-11:59pm) @ ShopBack

[bricks] Everyday Market is so confusing, is cashback on items from any seller on the platform? For example where it says ‘ Sold by Gadget & Gear Australia ‘ would these items be included?
[bohn] doesn't seem confusing.. just go to https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/explore/everyday-market and search some stuff
if it's there you're in.
I find that it's all a rip off - but I like using these large cashback on rip off items as I get a big cashback and then pricematch with 28degrees ;)
[raj koothrappali] I bought Airpods and Kindle off everyday market, huge cashback and they are both genuine.
[bohn] I didn't think they were fakes. Just overpriced.
[NedStark102] How does the price match work in that scenario? 28degrees pays you the difference between everydaymarket's price (not accounting for cashback) and a cheaper retailer's?
[A female dog] Is the 28degrees price match policy grandfathered and no longer applicable for new sign ups?
[payton] @bohn: Several times a year, they'd email us saying 'is this price protection still the right product for you??'
Nice try, Latitude, nice try
[bohn] @payton: haha I did read one guy saying he'd had price protection enabled for years and didn't know… so he paid 1% on all his purchases but never used it.
that guy should have read those emails!
[A female dog] @bohn: dayum, those that got in are cheering. I reckon I could easily make thousands a year in price matching items - there must be limits to it!
[payton] @A female dog: $20K max for the lifetime of the card.
A few people here saying they've hit the limit, I can't imagine what their monthly credit card bill looks like
Max of $1k claim per item.
[mmcs] just wondering if "Sold and shipped by Woolworths Group" is eligible?
[nismo] Yes. Just make sure you see the Orange Everyday Market logo on the listing.
I recently bought these from the Woolworths Group, with ~30% Cashback
https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1120634725…
[mmcs] thanks, hopefully they don't jack price or remove it.
[chillybags] Keen to buy this car seat but cant seem to work out how to find it once clicking through shopback? It doesnt come up on search.
https://www.everyday.com.au/shop/product/safe-n-sound-polar-…
[scud70] what a pointless cap … either have a spend cap or a cashback cap.
[zzyss] That'd make the Nintendo Alarmo $81 ($109 inc. delivery - $28) after/if cashback tracks, making it ATL: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/971830
